description: Ribalta, Marc and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented Decision Support Framework provides modules for PMT assessment, personalised diagnosis, solution assessment, strategy guidance and substance search. Its Solutions module was applied to five substance-use combinations across semi-closed drinking-water supply, wastewater reuse for irrigation and nutrient recovery from treated sludge. The official tool description establishes data visualisation and scenario comparison; no numerical contaminant-transport engine is claimed. Public frontend and backend releases are separate components under repository Apache-2.0 terms, while their Zenodo deposits and guidance have CC-BY terms. Quantitative exposure and treatment models retain separate identities. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
